video_title: Could This Be An EPIC Rookie Of The Year Battle In The NBA?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Boozer's strong position to win Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: Everything is going to be built around him in Memphis

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I talked to multiple people who were like, this is going to be Cameron Boozer's award. Everything is going to be built around him in Memphis. He's been the leader of every team he's ever been on. He's achieved with every team he's ever been on. His situation is totally set up to be featured.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: It's Boozer and why are you debating it? If he's healthy, he's going to win it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's opportunity to compete for Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: It really comes down to your opportunity

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Yes, opportunity is very important. For example, one of the reasons you would argue, because Darryn Peterson looked pretty damn good in the Summer Leagues, your case against Peterson winning it is an opportunity case because you need to have opportunity to win Rookie of the Year. It's not an award that's predicated on being on a winning team. And they're like, with Lauri Markkanen, and with Jaren Jackson, and with Keyonte George, and with Ace Bailey, how much is he going to have an opportunity?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: He'll get plenty of shots, I can assure you that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay Dybantsa's potential as a well-equipped rookie
quotes.excerpt: Dybantsa is the best equipped player to do this

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I talked to somebody else who I really trust and he's like, look, Dybantsa is the best equipped player to do this. He goes, last year, Kon Knueppel had great opportunity. They really, as the season went along, more and more and more, he took 10 threes a game. Is Peterson going to get to shoot 10 threes a game in Utah? He almost won the award because he had great opportunity, but he said, Cooper Flagg was the most equipped, and he ended up winning it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: It was close and honestly, it took Cooper Flagg when he came back from his injury having a hell of a finishing kick.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Caleb Wilson's potential impact with the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: I am compelled by Caleb Wilson

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: I am compelled by Caleb Wilson. I think the Bulls are going to invest everything into him. He does have to stay healthy, he's had some injury issues. I talked to some scouts and they were like, look, the thing about Caleb is that there are guys in Chicago who are going to want to put it up. This is going to be a potential really big year for Matas Buzelis because this is a year where if you're Buzelis, you're trying to prove you're the franchise player because next year is when you get paid. Tiago Splitter should be focused heavily on what he can get from Buzelis and Wilson together. And then Josh Giddey is a high usage player.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: You think Norm Powell went to Chicago on a short-term deal to launch?
